prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: finished transparent Korean title lettering for the opening screen of a polished elementary science forest adventure game.
Primary request: Design one premium, charming, beautifully legible Korean game-title logo reading EXACTLY "생명 시계 연구실".
Text layout: two centered lines: first line "생명 시계", second line "연구실". All seven Hangul syllables must be complete and correct: 생 / 명 / 시 / 계 / 연 / 구 / 실. The second line is slightly larger so the two lines have balanced width. No other text.
Style: high-end hand-painted 3D storybook game lettering, bold custom rounded Hangul with generous inner counters, warm ivory-to-honey-gold letter faces, subtle embossed golden edges, rich dark forest-green outer contour and slim walnut brown depth. Precise, joyful, crafted rather than metallic industrial. Letters are the hero and remain readable when displayed 480 pixels wide.
Decoration: only a few fresh small leaves sprouting from the outside corners, and one small antique brass pocket watch tucked at the upper-right edge. The watch and leaves support the lettering without covering or replacing any letter. No characters.
Palette: warm cream #fff3ce, honey gold #dfbb64, deep evergreen #244d39, moss #779867, restrained copper-brown shading. Soft warm sunlight from upper left.
Composition/framing: landscape canvas, compact two-line lockup centered, about 90% width occupied, 8% clear safe margin on all sides. Every ornament and soft shadow stays fully inside frame.
Background: genuine full alpha transparency, including gaps between letters. Isolated wordmark only, no background scenery, no plaque, no rectangle, no wooden sign board, no floor, no glow cloud.
Constraints: deliver production-ready crisp detailed raster artwork, strong silhouette, clean transparent edges, minimal restrained decoration, no English, no subtitle, no watermark.
